to add (to join one thing to another)

o.text:
From Proto-Turkic *koĺ- (“pair, couple, one of a couple; to join, unite”).
Cognate with Chuvash хуш (huš, “to add, attach”), etc.

glosses: set (a (mostly abstract) object made up of several parts)
collection (a set of items or amount of material procured or gathered together)
totality (an aggregate quantity obtained by addition)

o.text: Borrowed from Russian аэрология (aerologija). By surface analysis, aero- + -logiya.
